verdict.rationale: Gitleaks ships an official, well-documented CLI with clear subcommands (git, dir, stdin) and stdin piping support, making it easy to invoke programmatically or from agentic scripts/pipelines; it's installable via Homebrew, Docker, or Go. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of AI-agent-specific invocation patterns or machine-readable manifest (llms.txt/OpenAPI probes both 404).
